v5b.reason: Static Zenodo benchmark scenes lack authoritative UTC timestamps required for real ERA5 hourly alignment without temporal fabrication.

comparative_insights: V4 and V5-A exhibit identical radiometric normalization and architecture, with nearly identical validation performance (~3.8%–3.9% Dice, ~25%–26% FPR).

On held-out test scenes, V5-A demonstrates higher true positive sensitivity (62.7% recall) at the expense of higher false alarm rate (48.2% FPR), illustrating decision boundary sensitivity on flat Focal-Tversky loss surfaces.
Both models confirm high look-alike vulnerability (~86% validation look-alike FPR), demonstrating the theoretical limit of monomodal dual-pol backscatter.
Model V5-B is held under Phase 20 Stop Conditions until verified scene timestamps or live CDSE products are incorporated.
